$ -h status
rc 0
--- out
usage: truesense [-h] [--json] [-V] area ...

truesense: command line for the Acer Predator Helios 16 (PH16-71).   truesense <area> <verb> ...   (every setting has on / off / toggle / status; --json for scripts)

positional arguments:
  area
    status       everything at a glance
    sensors      temperatures and fan RPM
    power        power mode (quiet balanced performance turbo eco) and the
                 automatic profile
    mode         a look and a fan curve for each power mode, applied when the
                 mode changes
    fan          fans: firmware auto, max, manual %, smart curve
    battery      80 % charge limit, charge to full once, calibration, USB
                 power-off charging
    display      LCD overdrive
    boot         boot animation and sound
    gpu          GPU mode (MUX); a change needs a reboot
    rear         rear light bar
    update       check for a newer TrueSense and install it
    look         saved lighting looks (keyboard effect/brightness/colours +
                 rear light)
    startup      what the lights and profile do at login
    keyboard     keyboard lighting
    audio        output, microphone, headset jack, Purified Voice, DTS
    keys         PREDATOR key and Fn+Esc: what each gesture does
    profile      named bundles of settings (gaming, quiet, battery-saver,
                 yours)
    favourite    starred looks, fan curves, Smart profiles, profiles and
                 themes (the Home page and the PREDATOR key use them): list |
                 add KIND NAME | remove KIND NAME | move FROM TO | apply N |
                 apply KIND NAME | next
    theme        lighting themes drawn on the keyboard by the key service:
                 list | show NAME | apply NAME | stop
    cpu          CPU power limits and the guarded undervolt
    touchpad     touchpad on/off (Fn+F10)
    alerts       desktop alerts: hot CPU/GPU, low battery, throttling
    service      the daemon
    config       configuration
    doctor       check the whole stack and say how to fix problems
    selftest     set -> read back -> restore every firmware feature
    completion   shell completion script
    gui          the small optional window
    probe        read-only report of this laptop for model support (never
                 writes a setting)
    tui          the full control surface in the terminal (keyboard and mouse)
    daemon       run the daemon (systemd does this)

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --json         machine-readable output
  -V, --version  show program's version number and exit

Examples:
  truesense status
  truesense power set turbo
  truesense fan set 60
  truesense rear set breathing --color 00ff88
  truesense keyboard effect wave --brightness 50
  truesense keys set double output-toggle
  truesense profile apply gaming
  truesense doctor
--- err
=== end

$ power --h
rc 0
--- out
usage: truesense power [-h]
                       {status,list,set,next,prev,smart,auto,hold,release,managers,game} ...

positional arguments:
  {status,list,set,next,prev,smart,auto,hold,release,managers,game}
    smart               Smart auto profiles: list | current | show NAME | use
                        NAME | copy NAME [NEW] | save NAME [--from BASE] --set
                        key=value ... | delete NAME (built-in profiles are
                        read-only: copy them to edit)
    auto                automatic power mode: off | native (PredatorSense-
                        like: power source only) | smart (heat, load and
                        battery aware); on = smart
    hold                keep the current power mode against the automatic
                        profile
    release             end a hold
    managers            other power managers (auto-cpufreq, TLP, tuned, power-
                        profiles-daemon, system76-power): list | stop
                        (TrueSense manages power: stops them, sets sane CPU
                        defaults, remembers) | restore
    game                game rules: a program raises the power mode while it
                        runs: list | add NAME MODE | remove NAME | clear

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
--- err
=== end

_truesense() {
  local cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
  if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 1 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status sensors power mode fan battery display boot gpu rear update look startup keyboard audio keys profile favourite theme cpu touchpad alerts service config doctor selftest completion gui probe tui daemon version --json --help --version" -- "$cur") ); return; fi
  case "${COMP_WORDS[1]}" in
    status) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    sensors) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    power) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status list set next prev smart auto hold release managers game --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        status) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        list) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        set) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "quiet balanced performance turbo eco --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        next) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        prev) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        smart) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list current show use copy save delete --help --from --set" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        auto) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "off native smart on toggle status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        hold) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        release) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        managers) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list stop restore --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        game) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list add remove clear quiet balanced performance turbo eco --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    mode) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "bindings bind unbind apply --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        bindings) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        bind) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "quiet balanced performance turbo eco --help --look --curve" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        unbind) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "quiet balanced performance turbo eco --help --look --curve" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        apply) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "quiet balanced performance turbo eco --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    fan) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status auto max off set curve smart --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        status) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        auto) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        max) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        off) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --confirm" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        set) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --confirm" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        curve) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list current show use save delete copy --help --cpu --gpu --hysteresis --down-rate --predict --couple --battery-shift --from" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        smart) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off toggle status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    battery) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "full limit calibration usb-charge status --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        full) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "start cancel status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        limit) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off toggle status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        calibration) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off toggle status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        usb-charge) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status 0 10 20 30 --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        status) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    display) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "overdrive --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        overdrive) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off toggle status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    boot) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "sound --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        sound) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off toggle status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    gpu) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status set undervolt --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        status) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        set) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "optimus nvidia auto --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        undervolt) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "get list show use reset copy save delete boot --help --offset --cap --confirm --force" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    rear) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status on off toggle set --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        status) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        on) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        off) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        toggle) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        set) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "static breathing neon wave twinkling --help --color --speed --brightness --direction --zones" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    update) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "check apply auto auto-run --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        check) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --force" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        apply) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --yes --version" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        auto) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off toggle status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        auto-run) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    look) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list save apply show delete --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        list) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        save) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        apply) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        show) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        delete) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    startup) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "show apply boot set --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        show) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        apply) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        boot) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        set) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "keyboard rear profile --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    keyboard) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status on off toggle restore list-keys effect fx speed color paint layout design image fill gradient rainbow keys brightness timeout operating profile --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        status) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        on) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        off) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        toggle) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        restore) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        list-keys) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        effect) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --color --speed --brightness --direction" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        fx) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "off pulse wave cycle twinkle rainbow breathing scanner comet ripple rain matrix fire plasma aurora lightning confetti starlight mood wave-clockwise wave-counter-clockwise --help --speed --keys" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        speed) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        color) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        paint) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --brightness" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        layout) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        design) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list apply save --help --brightness" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        image) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --brightness" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        fill) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --brightness" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        gradient) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --brightness" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        rainbow) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --brightness" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        keys) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --base --brightness" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        brightness) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        timeout) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off toggle status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        operating) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        profile) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list load save delete --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    audio) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "output mic jack voice repair speaker-filter dts --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        output) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status speakers headphones toggle cycle --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        mic) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status mute unmute toggle volume boost --help --default-only" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        jack) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "auto headphones headset --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        voice) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status set enable disable next apply watch notify --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        repair) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        speaker-filter) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off status --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        dts) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status on off mode profiles devices all setup --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    keys) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "show actions run set reset test profile timing --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        show) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        actions) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        run) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        set) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "tap double triple long fn_esc --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        reset) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "tap double triple long fn_esc --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        test) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        profile) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list current show use copy save delete --help --from --tap --double --triple --long --fn-esc --long-ms --multi-ms" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        timing) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --long-ms --multi-ms" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    profile) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list next show apply save delete --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        list) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        next) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        show) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        apply) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        save) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --description" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        delete) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    favourite) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list add remove move apply next --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        list) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        add) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "look fan_curve smart_profile profile theme --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        remove) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "look fan_curve smart_profile profile theme --help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        move) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        apply) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        next) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    theme) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list show apply stop --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        list) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        show) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        apply) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --colourway --custom --set --speed --brightness" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        stop) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    cpu) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "info limits undervolt --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        info) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        limits) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --auto --force" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        undervolt) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "get list show use reset copy save delete boot set --help --core --cache --confirm --force --plane" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    touchpad) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "on off toggle status --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    alerts) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "show set --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        show) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        set) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --enabled --cpu-limit --gpu-limit --repeat-minutes --debounce-samples --battery-low --throttling --sensor-lost" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    service) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status restart logs check repair --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        status) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        restart) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        logs) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        check) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        repair) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --system" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    config) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "show validate path --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in
        show) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        validate) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        path) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); return;;
        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    doctor) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    selftest) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --skip-fans" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    completion) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "bash zsh fish --help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    gui) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --page" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    probe) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    tui) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help --page" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    daemon) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
    version) if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--help" -- "$cur") ); else case "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" in

        *) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--json" -- "$cur") );; esac; fi;;
  esac
}
